column3: a mere castle in the air (of the mind)
one whose senses are not conquered
the right to work destroys the bonds of the whole world
the abodes and perfections of action
the Self wasted by too much desire for pleasure
on the sandbank with bees and lotus ponds singing sweetly, the women
wife, sons, friends, relatives, homes, animals, belongings
for the cause of unrighteousness, a part
one whose mind is attached to the arts and letters
at the passing of the age
the Self in the form of a ray
by the parts of the immortals
the two descended in the age, the burden-demons of earth
the art, the unblinking, the makara
of those seized by the Kali planet
by the forest fire of Kali now
remover of the sorrow of Kali
at the end of Kali Yuga
and because of the abundance of Kali's faults
living by the livelihood of kalpa-lived
by the waters of the mixing of kalpas
you are fit for the path
the oceans swollen at the end of the kalpa
it was Kalpa, yoga and kshema (acquisition and protection)
headless bodies are in front, sinless one
the wise, O Lord, about you
the wise, supreme to the Unborn
for the beauty with the morsel, cane, horn and flute mark
the poet seeing nothing other than this
the poet seeing nothing else than you
in the dialogue of Kashyapa and Aditi
suffering came of the unconquered self

for what reason was there battle
once, with counsellors, Uddhava and others

banks covered with silk shining with girdle
even for a kakini of wealth
adorned with glass, gunja berries, gems and gold

one slender woman took with folded hands
some other like a mirror surface
adorned with girdle, bracelet, necklace and anklets

born of longing for the beloved
the deluded one with beloved mind
the beloved, the form of bliss, left, great torment
reddened by saffron of the breasts pressed on the beloved's body
(she) robbed in front of the beloved, by the wicked
that is carried on the shoulder
of mind agitated by desire, anger, great greed and thirst
even of those who conquered desire
by the difference in desired fruit
of those who desire as if desireless
assuming forms at will, bit the king
meditating on a trace of desire "I, mine"
of the two with desire and longing, a little
of desire, greed and so on
with mind bewildered by lust, greed, envy and delusion
for a trace of sensual pleasure
killer of Love, Tripura, Kalakuta poison etc.
hater of beings: Kama's sacrifice, Tripura, deadly poison and others
whose intellect was not attained by desires
with mind not struck by desires
one whose mind is not struck by desires, self-restrained
supported by the means of desire
born of the ripening of desire-actions
desire-oriented agnihotra and others, giving no peace
by desirable things for the sake of which here
Kamboja, Matsya, Kuru, Kaikeya, Srinjaya and others
knowing this body, by ignorance, desire and actions
body, in bowing and so on
from the body he took the head
with the body, the two lords of mountains
in the mortal form of cause
of the two causes of this
with the cause as limiting adjunct
from wretchedness carries on the shoulder
the Self as effect, cause and doer
reflection of the oneness of effect, cause and thing
with desire to do the task
made of iron, subduer of enemies
like swallowing with the digits of time
marked by the movement of time
by time, matter and qualities of him
whose desires were destroyed by time
although her fortune was burnt by time
for a long time, a sinful, impure, of excretion

Kalayavana, Magadha, Shalva and others with armies

approved in the form of time
